text:
sophia: quick heads-up - raven-lite int8 canary shows ~3.4% funcall JSON parse failures this morning. opening thread to decide quick mitigation.

rafael: ouch. any sample?

sophia: sample from logs:
```
{"action":"send_email","args":{"to":"ops@acme.com",}, // trailing comma and comment
```

priya: looks like trailing comma + inline comment. int8 seems to amplify generator noise.

tom: short-term fix: 1) run lightweight `jsonfixer` to strip comments, remove trailing commas, and auto-close braces when depth mismatch <=2. 2) if still invalid, do 1 re-ask with temp=0.0 and decode=top_k(1). 3) fallback to fp16.

rafael: add telemetry fields: `rescue_stage` and `rescue_reason` and `repair_time_ms`. important to measure repair vs reask effectiveness.

priya: also set re-ask token budget <= 48 and max_reasks=1 to control costs.

canary-bot: canary snapshot 2026-03-21T14:00Z: int8 parse_fail=3.41% (n=11.7k).

sophia: plan: deploy repair-only to canary for 24h, collect rescue telemetry, then evaluate re-ask experiment next sprint. i'll open PR to extend jsonfixer unit tests for trailing commas/comments and small brace imbalances.

tom: agree. i'll add dashboard slice for `rescue_stage` vs parse_fail_rate by model_variant.

rafael: make sure enterprise customers can opt out (header `x-model-preference: strict`) to always use fp16.

priya: sounds good. no blockers. ship repair-only canary.

sophia: thanks team — will post results here.
